title: Kystverket — AIS data access policy
text: The Norwegian Coastal Administration (Kystverket) operates a national AIS network covering Norwegian coastal waters and Svalbard. AIS data from this network is published as a real-time NMEA stream on TCP port 5631 at host 153.44.253.27 under the Norwegian Open Government Data Licence (Norsk lisens for offentlige data, NLOD 2.0). The licence permits free reuse, including for commercial purposes, on the condition that the source is credited. The historical AIS archive is available through Kystdatahuset on request. Users are expected not to overload the live socket; one persistent connection per consumer is the recommended pattern. For high-volume access or research collaboration, contact Kystverket directly. AIS data may not be used to identify individuals beyond the vessel's MMSI; combining AIS with personal data may trigger Norwegian privacy regulations.
